subject: sty
title: (R)STY.------INFO.F.
description: Second diagram on page 257 (PR.S(RD)II-11), paired with ALT-FT × SPT-GH above. This one names what style meets when information-focus is the working partner: (R)STY (the reality of style) crossed with INFO-F (information focus). STY sits on the right with the subject-arrow; INFO-F sits at center-bottom as partner-axis. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches left from the main line and carries INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), which carries ATTN (attraction). SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) drops from the main line and carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), which carries POST (postulation). AFI (affinity insight) branches left from the main line and carries PER-DY (perception dynamics) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), which carries RIT-DY (ritual dynamics).
